title: 《一個大事件》- 藝術季全貌

contents.text: 本展區介紹藝術季的脈絡，呈現從企劃發想到最終產出的過程，並以此補充展覽背後的科普知識。我們也邀請關心環境的藝術家共同展出，帶領大家透過作品認識藝術季的核心。

This section introduces the context of the art festival, presenting everything from initial concepts to the final results. It provides the scientific knowledge behind each project and features works by artists who care about the environment, guiding the public to understand the core of the festival.
